BUILDPLAN: M-13 — Wave 1 (§4)

Scope (verbatim): `POST /uploads/sign` → presigned **PUT against `{account}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`** (never a custom domain — trap 9), direct browser PUT with progress, `/complete` with HEAD verify + magic-byte sniff, Images variants for headshots, per-IP/per-submission caps in KV, nightly orphan sweep, separate-origin serving with `Content-Disposition: attachment`. **R2 canonical for media; Airtable only ever receives a public R2 URL (trap 10).** Turnstile is verified before a presign is issued; a magic-byte mismatch rejects **and deletes the object**.

Non-goal (EVALUATION §5): no malware scanning in this window — separate origin + `Content-Disposition: attachment` + `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, documented as an extension point.

File surface: `src/routes/uploads.routes.ts`, `src/lib/r2/*`

ACs: AC-52, AC-146 – AC-148, **AC-231** (presign gate), **AC-232**
Hours: 5
Workflow: inline-full
Shared files: none — module-local.
Deps: M-01
Audit that keys off this ticket: A-7 (public write surface), after M-13/M-14
Plan: filled in by delegator's plan phase

data.body: Plan-review phase: working against forgejo/master @ e9ce83ef61c16b616582c257c9205c4aad439c4d. Planning-only; no worktree or branch created.

Plan-review cycle 1 artifact art_01KZJMN1AJHF8N20CAZTSF2T9F returned FAIL. All 13 findings are triaged in the authoritative resolutions block: two schema blockers routed to MRQ-2; binding/scheduler/media-host seams routed to MRQ-1/MRQ-57; authenticated presigns use auth+scope rather than Turnstile; AC-52 ownership moved to MRQ-16; If-None-Match receives ETag fail-closed and CopyObject fallback.

Plan revalidated against forgejo/master @ 203dfa4 (MRQ-1 skeleton, MRQ-2 schema, MRQ-6 harness). Amendment block for genuine drift:

1. M-07 route registry is NOT merged (check:api is a stub owned by MRQ-9; no src/routes, no error-envelope/auth/429 helpers). Amendment: MRQ-14 registers its routes directly on the merged Hono app via a module-local registerUploadRoutes(app) and keeps minimal error-envelope/429/auth helpers module-local in src/lib/r2/http.ts; M-07 can later fold the definitions into its registry without behavior change. No second router, no check:api edit.
2. Schema confirmed: SPEC Amendment 12 is present in migrations/0001_init.sql (sha256 NULLABLE, r2_etag, ready=>etag CHECK, draft_file/submission_file owner types + indexes). No second migration.
3. M-01 seams absent as expected and confirmed mine per boot: S3 env/secret declarations in wrangler.jsonc, scheduled dispatch keyed by controller.cron (30 4 * * * -> orphan sweep), media.marquee.stage11.dev custom-domain route, /api/v1/media/* in run_worker_first, Worker-first media routing in src/index.ts.
4. aws4fetch not installed; adding as a runtime dependency (plan-approved signer pattern).
5. Trace contract (MRQ-6): every test title needs an AC-x/CONTRACT prefix. MRQ-14 claims file: owns [AC-231, AC-232], exercises [AC-52, AC-146, AC-147, AC-148]; non-AC lifecycle tests use CONTRACT prefix. Resolution-10 bundle scan implemented as a local Vite build plugin in vite.config.ts (fails the production build on signer markers / secret binding names in client assets) — no new package script.
6. No auth middleware is merged yet; authenticated presign authorization uses a module-local minimal principal resolver (mq_session cookie -> auth_sessions + memberships) per resolution 3, replaceable by M-07/MRQ-13 later.

Implementing now.

# Model switch: Kimi → Claude (operator decision, 2026-08-10)

This ticket's delegator was running on **Kimi** (Kimi Code / Moonshot, 15x coding
plan). Atin's call on 2026-08-10: the output is not meeting the bar, and the
remaining tickets move to **Claude**. Recording the exact state at handover so a
fresh delegator can decide what to keep rather than guess.

## State at handover

Branch `mrq-14-uploads`, worktree `../Marquee-worktrees/mrq-14-uploads`.
**Nothing is committed** — `master..HEAD` is empty.

| File | Lines |
|---|---|
| `src/lib/r2/policy.ts` | 155 |
| `src/lib/r2/protocol.ts` | 68 |
| `package.json` | modified — adds `aws4fetch ^1.0.20` |
| `package-lock.json` | modified |

**223 lines, zero test files.**

## ⚠️ Merge-boundary violation — resolve before this branch merges

`BUILDPLAN.md` §7 makes **`package.json` M-06-owned, with edits serialized through
the orchestrator**, precisely so parallel tickets don't collide in it. This branch
edits it anyway, and so does `mrq-8-api` (which adds `@hono/zod-openapi`, `zod`, and
`@scalar/openapi-parser`). Both also carry a regenerated `package-lock.json`.
Two branches editing the lockfile will conflict hard and the resolution is not
mechanical. Route the dependency additions through the orchestrator and rebase, or
land one and rebase the other before it grows further.

## Verify these against the contract before keeping the code

- **AC-231 / F-4** — Turnstile gates **every presign**, alongside draft *creation*
  and the submit. Autosave `PATCH …/drafts/:token` carries no challenge; the
  single-use resume token authorizes it and it is rate-limited per token in KV.
- **AC-232** — extension + MIME allowlist, **magic-byte sniff with deletion on
  mismatch**, per-IP and per-submission caps, and a **separate serving origin** with
  `Content-Disposition: attachment` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.
- Files go **browser → bucket by presigned PUT and never through the Worker**.
- Trap 8 in `BUILDPLAN.md` §10: presigned URLs on custom domains are a known
  failure mode — verify against the real deployed host, not `wrangler dev`.
- SPEC Amendment 12 pins the upload lifecycle schema (nullable `sha256`, `r2_etag`,
  draft/submission file relations). Confirm the code matches it.

## Contract changes to pick up before continuing

The worktree is on a pre-`1507bff` commit. Rebase on `master` first — the adversarial
pass closed out on 2026-08-10 and touched the harness contract:

- **`check:api` no longer asserts CLI-registry parity on every PR.** That half skips
  with a printed notice until `cli/` exists (MRQ-36 / M-38, Tier B rank 19). The
  served-JSON and rendered-docs half runs from the first PR. Before this fix, every
  PR opened against `check:api` failed on a registry no ticket has built yet.
- `SPEC.md` §4.2 names `/i/:uid.ics`, `/agenda.json` and the public SSR pages as a
  deliberate allowlist against the "`/api/v1` prefix throughout" rule.
- `EVALUATION.md` §1.2 adds the e2e split-do-not-delete rule; §5 records the
  desktop-only admin SPA as a non-goal.
- `SPEC.md` §3.9 gives the Airtable row counts a refresh owner (the daily keepalive)
  and renders them "as of `last_sync_at`".

Full disposition of the adversarial pass — 8/8 BLOCKING, 22/22 FIX, 8/8 NOTE — is in
`sequence/research/contract-adversarial.md`.
